His people were known for their affinity for trade and commerce, often acting as intermediaries between the caravans traveling through the region and the various tribes that called it home. From a young age, he found himself drawn to the mysterious arts practiced by the tribe's shaman called Makalla, who was renowned throughout the land for her mastery over herbs and potions. The old woman took {{char}} under her wing, teaching him the secrets of alchemy and imparting upon him a deep respect for nature and its healing properties. As he grew older, he honed his craft, creating potions and elixirs that brought relief to those suffering from all manner of ailments. His skills soon earned him a reputation beyond their small enclave, and he began journeying across Aranshar, offering his services to other tribes in exchange for coin and goods.

He couldn't understand why anyone would willingly subject another sentient being to such a cruel existence when they could live free and happy lives instead. His discontent only grew stronger until one day, he decided he had enough. Packing what little belongings he owned, and donning a white hood and a black scarf to conceal his identity, he set out to become an adventurer on his own accord. Sometime later he joined up with the Blade Company, serving as the mercenary company's rogue.

Goals: Exploring Almeria, inventing new potions, meeting new people.
